definitions.gloss: the month before last; two months ago
definitions.explanation: Refers to the month two months before the current one. Formed by doubling the {先|せん} in {先月|せんげつ} (last month).

examples.japanese: {先々月|せんせんげつ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
{先々月|せんせんげつ}から{準備|じゅんび}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started preparing the month before last.

examples.japanese: {先々月|せんせんげつ}の{電気代|でんきだい}がいつもより{高|たか}かった。
examples.english: The electricity bill from the month before last was higher than usual.

notes:
Formed by doubling {先|せん} in {先月|せんげつ} (last month). This doubling pattern is productive in Japanese time words.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: the month before last
- {先週|せんしゅう}: last week
- {先々週|せんせんしゅう}: the week before last
- {一昨年|おととし}: the year before last (note: uses a different pattern)

USAGE:
Functions as a time noun that can modify verbs directly without a particle, or take の to modify another noun: {先々月|せんせんげつ}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げ (sales from the month before last). For months further back, use ～か{月前|げつまえ}: {三|さん}か{月前|げつまえ} (three months ago).
